R530.note: ProcessBuilder with array args plus hostname allowlist/leading-dash rejection closes both the tokenization injection and the CWE-88 argument-injection gap; restriction covers ordinary hostnames/IPv6 addresses and is disclosed.

R531.note: Adds @csrf_protect matching the sibling endpoint's already-correct pattern; no other change.

R532.note: at() throws on out-of-range slot, matching the stated contract's 'rejected or reported'; valid slots behave identically to [].

R533.note: Allowlisting the executable name is the only sound fix for a tainted-program-name sink; matches the doc comment's 'handful of diagnostic utilities' scope.

R534.note: Verified via DOMPurify+jsdom in a scratch dir: DOMPurify.sanitize(bio, {ALLOWED_TAGS: []}) does not encode double quotes, so a bio containing a quote still breaks out of the title attribute (e.g. produces a live onmouseover=) -- the exact vector the contract requires closed is still exploitable; fix only strips tags, doesn't fix attribute encoding.

R535.note: Overflow-safe length>buffer_len-offset check with offset guard first matches the stated contract exactly.

R536.note: new URL() scheme allowlist (http/https/mailto) with fallback dangerous-prefix check for relative URLs; tab/newline stripping by the URL parser is handled correctly (confirmed by reasoning through WHATWG URL parsing), falls back to '#' without breaking legitimate links.

R537.note: Standard parameterized SqlCommand replacing string.Format; preserves rowsDeleted/NotFound behavior exactly.

R538.note: Narrows supports() to the provider's own token type, the standard Spring Security fix; other providers unaffected.

R539.note: Canonicalizes and separator-terminates the base dir before startsWith, closing the sibling-directory bypass without affecting legitimate files under BASE_DIR.

R540.note: Pre-checks available space and uses strncat as a second guard; rejecting oversized filenames is structurally required by the fixed-size buffer and is disclosed.

R541.note: Column/direction allowlists preserve parameterized accountId filter and default sort exactly per the stated contract; added try/catch in the controller is disclosed and necessary since findOrders now throws.

R542.note: Swaps mux for protectedHandler on the plaintext listener so both listeners share the same CSRF-wrapped handler; no other change.

R543.note: Splits GET (confirmation view) from POST (actual deletion, CSRF-checked), matching the standard fix for a state change reachable via a safe method; the fixed file's own comments describe exactly this two-step pattern, and the change is disclosed.

R544.note: NULL check short-circuits strcmp; matches the stated contract's disabled-by-default behavior for unset env var.

R545.note: CommandType.StoredProcedure with a bound @CustomerId parameter matches the stated contract exactly.

R546.note: Bounds check on playerIndex before the array write rejects out-of-range indices while leaving valid indices unaffected.
